page.overview:
What is Balduvia?

Balduvia was a nation of barbarians north of the Karplusan Mountains during the time of the Ice Age on Terisiare (Dominaria).

The Balduvians mainly inhabited the Balduvian Steppes north-west of Kjeldor. They were divided into clans, such as the Blue Storms and the Gray Fishers.

The Balduvians rose as a people after the start of the Ice Age, overtaking the role of the Malpiri nation inhabiting the great plans in northern Terisiare, and possibly also being of Malpiri ancestry themselves.

Balduvian barbarians were mainly hunters but kept a few more permanent settlements there. In addition to the Balduvian Steppes, they traditionally also claimed the lands south of the Karplusan Mountains. These lands were settled by refugees from Storgard and became part of the nation of Kjeldor. Around 2500 AR, Balduvia declared war on Kjeldor over their ancestral lands, starting a 400-year-long period of strife between the two nations.
